newsitem.title: USA: Schering CLARITIN RediTabs get marketing OK.
newsitem.headline: Schering CLARITIN RediTabs get marketing OK.

text.p: Schering-Plough Corp said it received marketing clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for CLARITIN RediTabs, an allergy drug which does not cause drowsiness and is available in a rapidly disintegrating tablet.
CLARITIN RediTabs disintegrate almost instantly in the mouth, Schering said, and relieve seasonal allergy symptons.
The company said the product would be available nationwide by prescription in early March 1997.
CLARITIN RediTabs can be administered to adults and children as young as 6 years of age, the company said.
The Zydis delivery system of CLARITIN RediTabs is licensed from R.P. Scherer Corp, a drug delivery technology company, Schering-Plough said.
